query: Consider the following context: During the hot dip aluminum plating process, components such as sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates will come into long-term contact with high-temperature liquid aluminum and be corroded by the aluminum liquid, greatly reducing their service life. In that context, which material can be used for prepare parts for the dipping and plating equipment and protect the equipment from erosion, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Using high-temperature corrosion-resistant alloys like nickel-based or iron-based alloys for the preparation of parts for the dipping and plating equipment can protect the equipment from erosion by liquid aluminum.
generation.material_initial_state: Components such as sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates made of common materials
generation.intervention: Replacing common materials with high-temperature corrosion-resistant alloys like nickel-based or iron-based alloys
generation.conditions: High-temperature environment of the hot dip aluminum plating process
generation.structural_mediator: Microstructure and composition of the alloys
generation.mechanism: Alloying or material selection for corrosion resistance, providing a barrier against liquid aluminum corrosion
generation.predicted_outcome: Reduced corrosion and increased service life of the equipment
generation.baseline: Current service life of equipment made of common materials
generation.boundary: Temperature and duration of exposure to liquid aluminum
generation.uncertainty: The exact increase in service life and the optimal composition of the alloys for maximum corrosion resistance

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative study of equipment made of common materials versus high-temperature corrosion-resistant alloys in the hot dip aluminum plating process
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the equipment made of high-temperature corrosion-resistant alloys shows no significant increase in service life or reduction in corrosion rate compared to equipment made of common materials, the hypothesis is falsified.
